description: Fixed AnnData contract for all GEO datasets processed by this project. Missing source values remain null; datasets do not define new columns.

X.meaning: expression values as supplied; record whether raw counts, normalized values, or unknown in uns.matrix_semantics

counts.meaning: populate only when raw counts are confirmed and dimensions and order match X

index.name: cell_id
index.rule: unique; construct as <sample_id>:<source_barcode> when source barcodes are only sample-unique

sample_id.meaning: GEO GSM accession when explicitly mapped

cell_type.meaning: per-cell annotation; leave null until cell annotation is performed

n_counts.meaning: derived QC field; do not invent before matrix semantics are established

percent_mito.meaning: derived QC field; requires a declared mitochondrial feature annotation

index.name: feature_id
index.rule: unique within the object; preserve source identifiers

feature_type.meaning: for example Gene Expression or Antibody Capture when supplied

uns.matrix_semantics: raw counts, normalized values, or unknown; never infer silently
uns.feature_id_namespace: source feature identifier namespace when known
uns.harmonization_notes: explicit mapping, conversions, and unresolved differences

enforcement_rules: Use this exact column set and declared dtypes for every dataset; do not add dataset-specific obs or var columns.
Keep unavailable metadata fields present with null values; do not omit contract columns or guess values.
Keep obs rows aligned to X rows and var rows aligned to X columns.
Keep cell_type null until per-cell annotation is performed; do not copy sample-level cell labels into it.
Record raw counts, normalized values, or unknown for matrix_semantics; never normalize data of unknown semantics automatically.
